label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Caddie Gaugert’s New Role
items.text: Austin Gaugert is now caddying for Dylan Wu at the Charles Schwab Challenge after accepting blame for Garrick Higgo's two-stroke penalty at the PGA Championship that caused Higgo to miss the cut by one.

items.headline: PGA Tour Schedule Controversy
items.text: PGA Tour players are upset with CEO Brian Rolapp’s plan to split 2028 into “track one” and “track two” events, restricting stars like Scottie Scheffler and Jordan Spieth from playing lower-tier tournaments which may run opposite higher-tier weeks.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau on LIV Golf
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau leads LIV Golf Korea after a 5-under 65 first round, praising LIV’s team format as “underrated” and emphasizing its fun and strategic aspects amid questions about LIV’s future funding.
